description: Gobierno de Aragón: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de Aragón. Coverage: Gobierno de Aragón. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Red ferroviaria de Aragón; Transporte interior de viajeros por ferrocarril en cercanías urbanas e; Transporte interior de viajeros por ferrocarril en media distancia y l; Transporte interior de mercancías por ferrocarril en media y larga dis. Formats seen: HTML, JSON, WMS_XML, CSV, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
